variants.headline: Still in view: building job cancelled part-way
variants.sub: The client has abandoned {project}, which {builder} was building.
variants.body:
The building job for {project}, undertaken by {builder}, has been cancelled part-way. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

The gazette records cancellation during the work, rather than the completion of the building. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
